question: Do the BANC counterparts (by neuron-level match) of the model's own MaleCNS T1 SNpp45 neurons show the MaleCNS right-front vs left-front deficit in count and size?
seen_before_registration: V1 post-hoc diagnostics (type-name rule): BANC T1 primary 8 L / 4 R, median cable 1346 / 1027 um; all single prothoracic nerves 22 L / 26 R.
Whole-table formats only: BANC malecns_match single body-ID strings; manc_match body-ID strings, occasionally comma-separated; annotations mancBodyid float.

anchors.rule: hair_plate_identity.sensory_sets on the annotations (type SNpp45; VProN/MesoLN/MetaLN; rootSide else somaSide); body IDs, no connectome needed
anchors.reported: Step A excluded body 821165 (ProLN, left); T2 and T3 anchors as context

bridges.B1: BANC rows with malecns_match (as integer) == anchor bodyId
bridges.B2: BANC rows whose manc_match, split on commas, contains int(anchor mancBodyid) (anchors without mancBodyid have no B2)
bridges.counterparts: union of B1 and B2 rows, distinct by root_id
bridges.side: BANC side column if left/right, else side prefix of the nerve name, else unusable (reported)

measures.n_side: distinct T1 counterparts with side == s whose anchor (any one) is on side s
measures.size: median and sum of BANC l2_cable_length_um over those counterparts

integrity.I1_sources: BANC sha = 86ccf5df... = provenance; annotations sha 2177e246...; Step A sha e652a0c2...; anchors reproduce Step A counts 7/5/12/11/8/9
integrity.I2_bridge_version: >= 0.90 of distinct non-null integer BANC malecns_match IDs exist as annotations bodyId
integrity.I3_coverage: >= 0.75 of T1 anchors on each side have >= 1 counterpart
integrity.I4_side_consistency: >= 0.80 of distinct T1 counterparts (usable side) have the side of their anchor (a counterpart is consistent if any of its anchors is on its side)
integrity.I5_size_field: every counted T1 counterpart has finite positive l2_cable_length_um

Q_SIZE.r: median cable(R counterparts) / median cable(L counterparts)

Q_RF.RF_DEFICIT_NOT_REPLICATED: Q_COUNT in {COUNT_SYMMETRIC, COUNT_REVERSED} and Q_SIZE in {SIZE_SYMMETRIC, SIZE_REVERSED}

labels.primary: Q_SIZE is the more informative label; counts are bounded by matching

consequence_declared_in_advance: No weights, thresholds or mappings change. REPLICATED: joint_RFCoxa stays BLOCKED_BY_INPUT, documented as a likely property of the fly (or a shared reconstruction bias). NOT_REPLICATED: MaleCNS-specific (individual variation or under-tracing); any input substitution is a separately designed labelled engineering question, only on the user's decision. PARTIAL: recorded as is. COXA_COORDINATE_STATUS.md gets one evidence line; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +2 conditional.
interpretation_limits: Two animals; replication or not, not population anatomy.
Size proxies differ; sizes compared only within BANC.
Matches are BANC's curated annotations, not audited here; an unmatched anchor is ambiguous.
Counts are matching-bounded: BANC-only neurons are invisible.
